t: What the Qur'an is said to do to a mountain
a: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَـٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
p: Law anzalnā hādha-l-qur'āna ʿalā jabalin la-ra'aytahu khāshiʿan mutaṣaddiʿan min khashyati-llāh…
m: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
